key_finding: lunch.order is a single-line model (no separate lunch.order.line); wallet debit occurs at ordered state via a SQL UNION view (lunch.cashmove.report); no accounting integration; no auto_confirm; no _confirm_many(); each supplier and alert owns a dedicated ir.cron.

migration_risks.description: lunch.cashmove.report is a SQL view (UNION). Must be recreated in target DB; not migrated as a regular table.
Each lunch.supplier and lunch.alert creates a dedicated ir.cron. Migrating suppliers/alerts without recreating crons breaks email and notification flows.
lunch.order has no separate line model. Integrations expecting lunch.order.line will fail. Quantity is on lunch.order directly.
lunch.supplier.company_id is a stored related from partner_id.company_id. Setting company on supplier requires setting it on the linked res.partner.
Wallet debit is at ordered state (not confirmed). Wallet balance includes in-flight (ordered, not yet confirmed) orders. Custom reports must query the SQL view or replicate the UNION logic.
Order merge logic (deduplication on create/write) is in Python, not SQL constraints. Bulk import bypassing ORM may create duplicate lines.
